summary: Regression sweep for post-refactor changes across auth.py, appointments_pos.py, gift_cards.py, premium_membership.py, eod_digests.py, crm.py, wallet_pass.py. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter102_refactor_regression.py covering all 8 requested flows. 13/13 assertions passed (cleanup step skipped due to env vars not exported, handled manually via motor script — 1 test gift card + 1 test gift-card invoice deleted from Mongo). No 500s, no behavioral regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: appointments_pos.py is 547 lines — still within limits but growing; consider splitting invoice creation into its own submodule if more helpers are added.

_gift_card_doc_from_item does a lazy import of routes.gift_cards._gc_settings inside the function. Since _gc_settings was moved to services.gift_card_service, prefer importing from services.gift_card_service directly to reduce circular-import surface (works today because gift_cards re-exports it, but the direct import is cleaner).

test_zzz_cleanup fixture depends on os.environ MONGO_URL/DB_NAME which are not auto-loaded from backend/.env by pytest — resulted in SKIPPED. Ideally load with dotenv inside the fixture so cleanup runs by default. This is a test-suite concern, not app code.
